children: Sysco reaffirmed fiscal 2027 guidance and announced a $500 million multi‑year AI‑powered efficiency program while raising mid‑term sales and EPS targets.
Reaffirms fiscal 2027 guidance: adjusted EPS growth of 9%–11% (53‑week basis) and net sales growth ~6%–7% to ~$90B.
Introduces at least $500M of AI‑powered efficiency savings targeted to be realized by fiscal 2029.
Maintains $100M of in‑year fiscal 2027 cost savings previously included in guidance.
Raises mid‑term algorithm: annualized net sales growth to 4%–7% (from 4%–6%) and adj. EPS growth to 9%–11% (from 6%–8%).
AI program focuses on routing, warehouse efficiency, merchandising/procurement automation, indirect spend, and back‑office simplification.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.

title: Sysco Reaffirms FY2027 Guidance, Launches $500M AI Efficiency Program and Raises Mid‑Term Targets
